goal: Write Solid-style code in other syntaxes (Solid TSX, solid-yield), lower it onto ReactiveScript's existing AST, and accept a program only if it behaves exactly like native Solid; refuse everything else. Direction: 'Solid' is a semantic model plus a conformance suite; syntaxes, hosts, runtimes, renderers and placement are plugins.
